actions.text: The AI advises against designing the UI first and recommends running the pipeline manually.
actions.evidence_quote: Short answer: no — don't design the UI first. Run the pipeline manually once, first.

actions.text: The AI explains why a UI-first approach is a trap for this specific project.
actions.evidence_quote: Designing screens gives you the feeling of clarity, but you'd be designing chat interfaces around a process you haven't actually executed yet.

actions.text: The AI provides a step-by-step plan for achieving clarity through manual execution.
actions.evidence_quote: What actually gives you clarity: do one full episode by hand. Today, in Claude chat, no code, no UI.

actions.text: The AI defines the core artifacts required for the system.
actions.evidence_quote: What you're really designing is not screens — it's the artifacts. Your system is essentially four documents flowing through stages

actions.text: The AI outlines the recommended order of operations for building the system.
actions.evidence_quote: So the order is: manual episode → write down the four artifact schemas → a rough flow sketch → Claude Code with an ugly functional UI → polish visuals last

actions.text: The AI warns the user about the complexity of automating too many stages at once.
actions.evidence_quote: One thing worth flagging: you've described eight-plus agent stages. As a solo builder, that's a lot of surface area

actions.text: The AI recommends building stages incrementally based on manual effort.
actions.evidence_quote: Build stages 1–3 first (ideation → story → screenplay), keep storyboard and video manual for now, and only automate a stage once you're bored of doing it by hand.

outcomes.text: Development plan for a language learning video production system and content pipeline
Series bible and content strategy for the German language learning show

requirements.text: The system must be automated using multiple agents.
requirements.rationale: The user explicitly states they want a platform automated with agents.

requirements.text: The system must feature persistent global context memory.
requirements.rationale: The user explicitly specifies the need for persistent global context memory in the platform.

requirements.text: The system design must be structured around four core artifact documents flowing through stages.
requirements.rationale: The AI explicitly defines the system as essentially consisting of four documents flowing through stages, establishing this as a core structural constraint.

requirements.text: The implementation roadmap must follow the sequence of: manual episode execution, defining the four artifact schemas, creating a rough flow sketch, developing a functional UI, and polishing visuals last.
requirements.rationale: The AI explicitly defines the specific order of operations for building the system.

requirements.text: The workflow strategy must begin with running one full episode of the pipeline manually (without code or UI) before any UI design or automation is initiated.
requirements.rationale: The AI explicitly rules out a UI-first approach ('don't design the UI first') and mandates that the user must first run one full episode manually in chat with no code and no UI to establish workflow clarity.

requirements.text: The show must target German language learning from levels A1 to B1, using 4-character narrative stories formatted as 30-second Instagram reels.
requirements.rationale: The user explicitly defines the target language (German), levels (A1 to B1), format (30-second Instagram reels), and structure (4-character narrative stories) for the show.

requirements.text: The series bible must define 4 characters (with wants, flaws, and relationships), the town/world, the visual identity, and the tone.
requirements.rationale: The AI explicitly lists these components as the required elements of the series bible artifact.

requirements.text: The season arc of the show must be mapped to the language learning curriculum.
requirements.rationale: The AI instructs that mapping the season arc to the curriculum is a necessary part of the series bible and season map artifact.

requirements.text: The episode format template must be structured as a 30-second format consisting of two 15-second sequences with a fixed structure.
requirements.rationale: The AI defines the specific structural template required for each episode.

requirements.text: The initial validation phase must involve manually producing and publishing episodes 1–3 to test audience engagement.
requirements.rationale: The AI instructs the user to publish the first three episodes completely by hand to validate the format before automating.

slots.text: Automation of storyboard and video stages (deferred to be kept manual initially, to be automated later based on manual effort).
